Class SimulationEngineConfig

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.SimulationEngineConfig
public final class SimulationEngineConfig extends Object
Configuration for SimulationEngine.

Intervals are used to rate-limit EDT events so the simulation thread can run fast while UI updates remain smooth and responsive.

    • refreshIntervalMs

      public final int refreshIntervalMs
      Target interval for posting refresh events to the EDT (milliseconds).

      Typical values: 16 (~60 Hz), 33 (~30 Hz), 50 (~20 Hz). Use 0 to disable periodic refresh.

    • progressIntervalMs

      public final int progressIntervalMs
      Target interval for posting progress "ping" events to the EDT (milliseconds).

      This is a fallback heartbeat. Many simulations will call SimulationEngine.postProgress(ProgressInfo) directly for determinate progress. Use 0 to disable periodic progress pings. If your simulation is determinate, you can set this to a large value (e.g., 1000 ms) to get occasional progress updates without flooding the EDT, or set to 0 to disable entirely and rely on explicit progress posts.

    • cooperativeYieldMs

      public final int cooperativeYieldMs
      Cooperative-yield rate limit for the simulation thread (milliseconds).

      Important: this value is not interpreted as "sleep this long each step". Instead, it acts as a minimum wall-clock interval between opportunities for the engine to yield CPU time.

      The engine implements this by calling Thread.yield() at most once per cooperativeYieldMs. This is intentionally light-weight: using park/sleep in a tight simulation loop can deschedule the thread and incur OS timer granularity delays (often orders of magnitude larger than the requested duration), which can devastate performance.

      Use 0 to disable cooperative yielding for maximum throughput. If you need to intentionally reduce CPU usage, try small values such as 1–10 ms.

    • autoRun

      public final boolean autoRun
      Whether the engine should transition to RUNNING immediately after READY.

      If false, the engine will stop at READY until SimulationEngine.requestResume() (or SimulationEngine.requestRun()) is called.

      public SimulationEngineConfig(int refreshIntervalMs, int progressIntervalMs, int cooperativeYieldMs, boolean autoRun)
      Create a configuration.
      Parameters:
      refreshIntervalMs - refresh interval in milliseconds (0 disables periodic refresh)
      progressIntervalMs - progress interval in milliseconds (0 disables periodic progress ping)
      cooperativeYieldMs - minimum interval between cooperative yields in milliseconds (0 disables yielding)
      autoRun - if true, RUNNING starts immediately after READY
